name: bto-cv
description: Convert original CVs into editable BTO Word documents and rank candidates against job descriptions with evidence-based scores.

interface.shortDescription: Original CV in. Editable BTO Word CV out.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached original CV into an editable BTO Word document in English, preserving wording except for necessary translation and cleanup.
Create a fictional BTO Word CV to test the formatting and native bullet lists.
Use $score to rank the attached CVs against each job description and update my configured shared Excel shortlist for candidates scoring at least 80/100.
interface.longDescription: Create an editable .docx using the BTO reference banner, Century Gothic fonts, measured spacing and native square bullet lists. Preserves supplied facts. Includes a deterministic Word generator and optional HTML preview. Includes Score for JD-specific candidate rankings, language flags and shared Excel shortlists.
